setupHelp: Create the first administrator. Use the setup token supplied by your server operator.
setupDone: Setup complete. Sign in with your new account.
name: Full name
passwordHelp: Use 12–128 characters. Give temporary passwords to users privately.
forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your office administrator to reset it.
resetHelp: This signs the person out on all devices. They must change the temporary password at their next sign-in.
validation: Check this field. Complete required fields and follow the requested format.
changeRequiredHelp: Replace the temporary password before continuing.
emptyPeople: No other people yet. Add employees and support staff to get started.
choosePerson: Choose a person to edit their access and delivery details.
accessHelp: Inactive people cannot sign in. Their records are kept.
homeHelp: Your account is ready. Your administrator will make refreshments available here.
notAllowed: This section is for authorized staff only.
setupTrustHelp: Each device must trust the office server’s certificate authority before you enter a setup token or password. These reminders do not establish initial trust: follow the operator’s offline deployment instructions first. Bypassing a certificate warning is not enough.
setupCertificate: Ask the operator for public-root.crt over an authenticated channel or in person, and verify its SHA-256 fingerprint with them separately. Never install or share a private key or the server’s .env file.
setupDesktopHelp: Windows: import the verified certificate into Trusted Root Certification Authorities for your user. macOS: import it in Keychain Access and explicitly trust it for SSL. Linux: ask your administrator to add it to your distribution’s CA trust store. Firefox may need a separate import under Settings → Privacy & Security → Certificates → View Certificates → Authorities; allow it to identify websites.
setupAndroidHelp: In Settings → Security (or Security & privacy) → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate, select the verified public-root.crt. Menu names vary by device; a screen lock may be required. Use a browser that accepts user-installed CAs; not every app does.
setupIosHelp: Open the verified public-root.crt, then install the downloaded profile in Settings → General → VPN & Device Management. Next open Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings and enable full trust for this root certificate. Installing the profile alone is insufficient.
setupVerify: Reopen the exact HTTPS address supplied by the operator and confirm there is no certificate warning. Only then use the privately supplied setup token to create the first administrator. Completed installations show sign-in instead; setup cannot be reopened.
setupLanOnly: Use the office LAN or Wi-Fi. This does not provide remote access. A hostname must already resolve on each client through office DNS; changing the server’s hosts file does not configure phones. Ask the operator to reserve the server’s LAN address.

realtime.connecting: Connecting… Displayed data may be out of date.
realtime.disconnected: Live updates disconnected. Displayed data may be out of date.
realtime.offline: Offline. Displayed data may be out of date. Orders cannot be sent.
realtime.refreshing: Refreshing authoritative data… Displayed data may be out of date.
realtime.suspended: Live updates paused while the app is in the background. Displayed data may be out of date.

emptyMenu: No refreshments on the menu yet.
retryHelp: This order is locked until its outcome is known. Retry the same order safely; do not start another request.
orderPlaced: Order placed. Your refreshments are on the list.
pwaInstallHelp: Install from your browser menu (Install app / Add to Home Screen). The app fits phone, tablet and desktop screens.
pwaInstalled: Office Service is running in its installed window.
pwaIos: On iPhone or iPad (iOS/iPadOS 16.4+), open in Safari, choose Share → Add to Home Screen, then launch the Home Screen app before enabling notifications.
pwaPrerequisites: Use the trusted office HTTPS address. Install the office root certificate first; iOS also requires full trust in Certificate Trust Settings. Server and device need internet access to Apple, Mozilla or Google push services, even on an office-only LAN. Ask your operator if private-CA push is unavailable.
pwaUnsupported: Notifications are unsupported here. Use a supported browser over trusted HTTPS or the iOS Home Screen app. Ordering and staff work still work without notifications.
pwaDenied: Notifications are blocked. Change this site's permission in browser/device settings, then return. Staff work remains available.
pwaUnavailable: Notifications are unavailable: the operator must configure valid VAPID keys, or the server could not be reached.
pwaEnabled: Notifications enabled for this account and this device session. Signing out ends them.
pwaExplicit: Notifications are optional. Only the button below requests permission; delivery is best-effort.

errors.PUSH_UNAVAILABLE: Notifications could not be enabled. Confirm installation, trusted HTTPS and internet access, then retry.
errors.ORDER_CONFLICT: This order has changed or is already complete. Refresh the queue and try again.
errors.ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: A selected refreshment is unavailable. Update your selection and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This retry does not match the original order. Keep the draft and contact your administrator.
errors.ORDER_NOT_PENDING: Only pending orders can be cancelled. Refresh your orders.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the entered values and try again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The username or password is incorrect.
errors.SETUP_COMPLETE: Setup is already complete. Sign in instead.
errors.INVALID_SETUP_TOKEN: The setup token is incorrect. Ask your server operator.
errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: That username is already in use. Choose another.
errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: This person could not be found. Refresh the list.
errors.LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN: Keep at least one active administrator.
errors.INVALID_ORIGIN: This request came from an untrusted address. Open the configured app address.
errors.BODY_TOO_LARGE: The request is too large. Shorten the entered text.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait one minute and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This page or record could not be found.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: This action could not be completed. Try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the office server. Check your office network and try again.
